functions.name: invoke_ai
functions.title: Invoke AI Assistant
functions.description: Runs an AI operation on the Nurse Master IA nursing platform. Use this to generate nursing care plans (PAE) with NANDA/NOC/NIC taxonomies, get clinical chat answers, check drug interactions, recognize medications from images, or search the web for clinical guidelines. Pass an 'action' from the allowed list and a 'prompt' with the clinical question or instructions.

prompt.description: The clinical prompt or question for the AI.

model.description: Optional model override. Defaults to gemini_3_flash. Non-admin users are restricted to economical models (automatic, gemini_3_flash, gpt_5_mini).

file_urls.description: Optional list of image file URLs for visual analysis (e.g. medication photos).

response_json_schema.description: Optional JSON schema to force structured JSON output instead of plain text.

add_context_from_internet.description: Optional. Set true to let the AI search the web for current clinical guidelines. Only works with gemini models.
